raw.docstring: Summarize new customer emails in the AR shared mailbox every weekday morning. Reads unread mail from ar@nordlicht.example via Microsoft Graph, asks GPT for a short summary per thread, and writes the digest to ar_digest.xlsx on the Finance SharePoint. Runs from cron at 07:30 (Mon-Fri).
prompts: You are an assistant for the accounts receivable team at Nordlicht. Summarize each customer email thread in 3 bullets: who the customer is, what they are asking about (invoice copy, payment status, dispute, dunning reply, remittance advice), and the suggested next step for AR. Flag anything that mentions a dispute or legal action.

raw.docstring: Weekly pipeline report for #sales-leadership. Pulls open opportunities from Salesforce, has Claude write the narrative, posts to Slack. Scheduled Mondays 08:00 via cron.
prompts: Write the weekly pipeline report for the Nordlicht sales leadership channel. Sections: 1) pipeline total and change vs last week, 2) new opportunities > 20k EUR, 3) stage changes, 4) deals whose close date slipped, 5) top 5 deals at risk with a one-line reason. Use short bullets, EUR, and name the opportunity owner.
